app_tagline: Meter readings and invoicing for real estate agents
login_subtitle: Sign in with your Google account. No separate password is needed.
login_terms: By continuing you agree to the processing of your Google profile data (name, email, photo) for signing in.
login_error_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Please try again.
login_error_invalid: The sign-in session has expired. Please try again.
login_error_google: Google could not confirm the sign-in. Try again or come back later.
login_hero_text: RentAudit runs a monthly cycle for each of your apartments — you step in only when something looks off.
login_cycle_collect_text: Tenants photograph water, gas and electricity meters.
login_cycle_check_text: Gemini reads the meter, history confirms the value.
login_invite_hint: A tenant? Open the invite link from your agent.
realtor_dashboard_subtitle: The state of your apartments and what needs attention
empty_apartments_text: Then you can add meters and invite a tenant.
tenant_home_text: Your readings, invoices and notifications will appear here.
error_text_404: This page does not exist or has been moved.
error_text_403: You do not have permission to view this page.
error_text_500: We know about the problem. Please refresh the page later.
discard_text: The data you entered will be lost.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_invalid_reading: The reading must have only digits within the meter's digit count
err_reading_lower: The reading cannot be lower than the previous one
invite_from: {name} invites you to become the tenant of this apartment.
invite_accept_google: Accept and sign in with Google
invite_hint: You will see your apartment, submit meter readings and view invoices.
invite_error_invalid: This link is invalid. Ask your agent for a new one.
invite_error_expired: The invitation has expired. Ask your agent to create a new one.
invite_error_used: This invitation has already been used or cancelled.
invite_error_taken: This apartment already has an active tenant.
invite_error_has_lease: You are already renting another apartment.
invite_error_role: Only tenants can accept invitations. Sign in with a different Google account.
apartments_subtitle: All your apartments, tenants and rent
apt_delete_text: The apartment, its meters, readings and invitations will be permanently deleted.
apt_delete_has_tenant: You cannot delete an apartment with an active tenant. End the lease first.
meter_digits_hint: Digits before the decimal point, 3 to 10
meter_initial_hint: A number with up to three decimals
meter_empty_text: Add water, gas and electricity meters with their initial readings.
meter_delete_text: This cannot be undone. If the meter has readings, deactivate it instead.
meter_delete_has_readings: This meter has readings. Deactivate it instead of deleting.
invite_card_text: Create a one-time link valid for 7 days. After opening it, the tenant is linked to this apartment and the lease is created automatically.
invite_active: An invitation is active until {date}. The link itself is shown only right after it is created.
invite_regenerate_text: The previous link will stop working.
invite_link_text: Send this link to the tenant.
invite_link_warning: The link is valid for 7 days and works once. It cannot be viewed again after you close this window.
lease_end_text: Enter the move-out meter readings. The apartment will become vacant.
reading_empty_text: They will appear once the tenant submits readings.
tenant_no_lease_text: Your lease has ended or no invitation was accepted yet. Contact your agent.
tenant_no_meters: Your agent has not added meters to your apartment yet.
tenant_manual_hint: Enter the current readings from your meters
tenant_readings_all_sent: All readings for this month are already submitted. Thank you!
tenant_readings_nothing: Enter a reading for at least one meter.
tenant_readings_sent: Readings submitted. Your agent can see them right away.
tenant_history_subtitle: All the meter readings you have submitted
reading_digits_hint: Up to {digits} digits before the decimal point
settings_subtitle: Invoice payment details and the reminder schedule
settings_payout_text: Tenants will see them on invoices and pay straight to your account.
settings_schedule_text: Days of the month when the system reminds about readings and creates the rent invoice.
photo_take: Take a photo of the meter
photo_check_values: Check the value and correct it if needed.
photo_upload_failed: The photo could not be uploaded. Enter the reading manually.
photo_ai_unavailable: Automatic recognition is unavailable right now. Enter the reading manually.
tenant_photo_hint: Take photos of your meters or enter the readings manually
reading_edit_reason: Why did you change the recognized value?
reading_flag_unreadable: The photo could not be read reliably. The reading will go to your agent for confirmation.
reading_flag_type_mismatch: The photo seems to show a different type of meter. Make sure you are photographing the right one.
reading_flag_serial_mismatch: The serial number in the photo differs from the meter in the system.
reading_rejected_note: Your agent rejected the previous reading: {reason}. Please submit it again.
readings_subtitle: Readings from tenants that need your decision
readings_queue_empty_text: No readings are waiting for your decision.
reading_reject_text: The tenant will see the reason and submit the reading again.
reading_correct_text: The old and new values stay in the history together with the reason.
flag_lower_than_previous: The reading is lower than the previous one.
flag_digits_mismatch: The number of digits does not match the meter.
flag_type_mismatch: The meter type in the photo does not match the meter in the system.
flag_serial_mismatch: The serial number in the photo does not match the meter in the system.
flag_unrealistic_growth: The increase is unusually large compared with the normal consumption.
tariff_night_hint: For two-zone meters. If empty, the day price applies.
tariff_effective_hint: New invoices use the new price, issued ones keep the old one.
tariff_add_text: The price takes effect from the chosen date.
tariff_delete_text: A price that is already in effect cannot be deleted. Only planned prices can.
tariff_realtor_subtitle: The prices used to calculate utilities
invoice_create_text: A utilities invoice is calculated from confirmed readings, a rent invoice from the rent at the start of the month.
invoice_empty_text: Create your first rent or utilities invoice.
invoice_empty_no_tenants: Invoices can be issued for apartments with an active tenant.
invoice_period_utilities_hint: The month the readings are for
invoice_period_rent_hint: The month the rent is for
invoice_error_exists: An invoice for this period already exists. Cancel it to create a new one.
invoice_error_no_tenant: The apartment has no active tenant.
invoice_error_no_meters: There are no meters to calculate consumption for.
invoice_error_readings_missing: The tenant has not submitted the reading for meter No. {serial} this month.
invoice_error_readings_pending: The reading for meter No. {serial} is not confirmed yet. Review it in the Readings section.
invoice_error_missing_tariff: There is no current price for “{service}”. Add it in the Tariffs section.
invoice_error_negative: The reading of meter No. {serial} is lower than the previous one. Correct the reading.
invoice_error_no_payout: First set your payment details in settings.
invoice_error_not_draft: This is only possible for a draft.
invoice_error_not_open: The invoice is no longer awaiting payment.
invoice_issue_text: Total {total}. Once issued, the invoice cannot be edited, only cancelled.
invoice_paid_text: Confirm once you can see the money in your account.
invoice_delete_text: The draft will be deleted. You can create a new invoice again.
invoice_payout_missing: To issue an invoice, set the IBAN and recipient name in
invoice_tenant_paid_notice: The tenant reported payment on {date}. Check your account and confirm it.
invoice_cancel_text: An issued invoice cannot be edited: it is cancelled and a new one is issued. Both stay in the history.
invoice_reissue: Create a new invoice right away
invoice_reissue_hint: A draft with the same lines is created and can be corrected.
tenant_invoices_empty_text: Once your agent issues an invoice, it will appear here.
tenant_invoice_overdue: This invoice is overdue, it was due on {date}.
tenant_payment_text: Pay directly to your agent's account using these details.
tenant_paid_hint: Paid? Let your agent know. The agent confirms the payment once the money arrives.
tenant_paid_text: Your agent will see that you paid and confirm once the funds arrive.
tenant_paid_sent: You reported the payment on {date}. Waiting for your agent to confirm.
meter_replace_text: Enter the final reading of the old meter and the details of the new one. The month's consumption is calculated for both, and the serial number check moves to the new meter.
meter_replaced_note: Final reading {reading}. Replaced by meter No. {serial}.
reading_locked_note: A utilities invoice already exists for this period, so the reading cannot be changed. Cancel or delete the invoice to correct it.
notif_reading_pending: The reading of meter No. {serial} ({apartmentName}) needs confirmation
notif_tenant_paid: The tenant reported payment of invoice {number}
notif_readings_reminder: It is time to submit your meter readings
stats_subtitle: Monthly consumption for each apartment and service
stats_empty_text: Charts appear once readings have been confirmed for a few months.
anomaly_zero: Zero consumption: the meter may have stopped.
anomaly_above_median: Consumption of {value} is far above the usual {expected}. There may be a leak.
anomaly_below_median: Consumption of {value} is far below the usual {expected}.
anomaly_above_last_year: Consumption of {value} is far above the same month last year ({expected}).
anomaly_jump: Consumption of {value} rose by more than 50% compared with last month ({expected}).
anomaly_over_norm: Consumption of {value} exceeds the norm ({expected}) for the number of residents.
apt_residents_hint: Used to check consumption against the norm
err_date_in_past: The date cannot be in the past
rent_change_text: The new price takes effect from the chosen date. The tenant gets a notification and confirms they have seen it.
price_change_acked: Thanks, your agent will see your confirmation
tariff_empty_hint: Add a price, otherwise a utilities invoice cannot be created.
admin_users_subtitle: All registered users of the system
tariff_edit_in_effect: This price is already in effect, so only its value can be changed. Issued invoices keep the old price.
anomalies_subtitle: Every case of unusual consumption over time
anomalies_empty_text: Entries appear here when consumption differs from the usual.
